newsitem.title: USA: Kanawha Cty, W.Va., mulls $94 million school GOs.
newsitem.headline: Kanawha Cty, W.Va., mulls $94 million school GOs.

text.p: West Virginia's Kanawha County school superintendent has revived a proposed general obligation bond issue, scaling back the size to $94 million.

The plan was offered at a Thursday night school board meeting by Superintendent Jorea Marple. It would finance renovations and new equipment rather than new construction, and calls for consolidation and redistricting.
The board rejected a previous proposal from the school district's Blue Ribon study panel, which called for a $246 million bond issue to finance up to 20 new middle and high schools.
"Clearly the public and the board wanted a smaller initiative," Marple said.
Board members will discuss the proposal at their Jan. 23 meeting.
A potential date has not been set for the referendum.
